### 1. -default-linkage external: a DXIL knob. Does it drive
###    SPIR-V linkage, i.e. export without the `export` keyword?

$ dxc -T lib_6_3 -spirv -fspv-target-env=universal1.5 -default-linkage external variant-default-linkage-external.hlsl
[exit] 0x80004005
fatal error: generated SPIR-V is invalid: No OpEntryPoint instruction was found. This is only allowed if the Linkage or GraphARM capability is being used.
note: please file a bug report on https://github.com/Microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues with source code if possible

### 2. ...and the same source WITH the `export` keyword, as the
###    control: this is the form that does work.

$ dxc -T lib_6_3 -spirv -fspv-target-env=universal1.5 lib-export.hlsl
[exit] 0x00000000

### 3. dxc -link is the DXIL linker. Fed SPIR-V, what happens?

$ dxc -T lib_6_3 -spirv -fspv-target-env=universal1.5 -Fo lib-export.spv lib-export.hlsl
[exit] 0x00000000


$ dxc -T lib_6_3 -spirv -link -Fo linked.spv lib-export.spv
[exit] 0x00000001

dxc failed : Invalid DXIL container.
